svg.title: Black White
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study after an inspected primary museum photograph. Geometry approximate; vivid screen colour not calibrated. Two joined black lobes meet at the right edge; inward central white point and white left corners retained.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://dia.org/collection/black-white/50445; source object unknown; inspected 2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation.
